facts.text: Under the Columbus Catholic Promise Program, Ohio Dominican University covers remaining tuition and student services fees for Pell-eligible graduates of the Columbus Diocese's 11 high schools after applicable scholarships and aid are applied.

sources.title: Catholic Promise Program - Ohio Dominican University
sources.quote: The program will provide eligible students who graduate from one of the Columbus Diocese's 11 high schools with financial resources and support to help make an ODU education attainable.

sources.title: Catholic Promise Program - Ohio Dominican University
sources.quote: For those accepted to the Columbus Catholic Promise Program, ODU will also cover tuition and the student services fee* after all applicable scholarships and financial aid (including standard Federal Student Loans) have been applied.
